page_title: VER 0-0 LEC | Verona v Lecce 25/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
90+6' Celebrations are cut short for Verona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
90+5' The Verona players halt their celebrations as referee Davide Massa makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
90+4' Now Verona have a corner.
90+4' The ball from the free kick finds its way to Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
90+4' It seemed like Sandi Lovric (Verona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+3' Konan Ndri (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+2' Konan Ndri (Lecce) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
90+1' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' That will be all from Santiago Pierotti who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
90' Kieron Bowie (Verona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
87' Paolo Sammarco decides to make a substitution. Antoine Bernede will be replaced by Ioan Vermesan (Verona).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pol Lirola (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Rafik Belghali can be given a rest.
86' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
84' Konan Ndri (Lecce) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Valentini (Verona) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' The ball has crossed the sideline. Lecce are taking a throw-in.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lameck Banda leaves the pitch and Konan Ndri (Lecce) comes on.
78' The ball possession at the moment is 48:52.
75' Verona will take a corner kick.
75' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) finds a little space near the penalty spot and heads the corner from Lameck Banda goalwards, but the attempt goes miles wide of the right post.
75' The referee awards a corner and Lameck Banda (Lecce) goes over to take it.

74' Lameck Banda (Lecce) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
74' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
71' The free kick is taken by Lameck Banda (Lecce), but ball is cleared.
69' Victor Nelsson (Verona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
67' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) for his blatant foul.

65' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
63' Substitution. Amin Sarr (Verona) has come on for Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
62' The substitution has been made. Sandi Lovric (Verona) has replaced Tomas Suslov.
60' Rafik Belghali (Verona) dribbles into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
60' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Walid Cheddira (Lecce) replaces Nikola Stulic.
60' The substitution is prepared. Oumar Ngom (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Omri Gandelman.
58' Lameck Banda (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

57' Rafik Belghali (Verona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

56' Tomas Suslov (Verona) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
54' A cross from Rafik Belghali (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

53' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
52' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
51' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) is substituted due to injury. Paolo Sammarco gives a chance to Nicolas Valentini.
50' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
49' Lameck Banda (Lecce) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Verona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
42' Tomas Suslov (Verona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone reads it well and gathers the ball.
42' Martin Frese (Verona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
38' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Danilo Veiga (Lecce) and blew his whistle.
37' Lameck Banda (Lecce) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
37' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
36' Rafik Belghali (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
28' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
25' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
22' Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
20' Lameck Banda (Lecce) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
19' Lecce are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
14' Lecce enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
9' Great teamplay by Lecce as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Tomas Suslov (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
4' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Verona will kick-off.
Davide Massa got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
